items.title: The Book of kOA: A Comprehensive Blueprint for Inclusive Collaboration and Merit-Based Civic Governance
items.description: A manifesto and practical guide proposing kOA as a modular civic platform: turning knowledge into a public utility and translating agreement into coordinated, ethical action through auditable collaboration and governance.

items.title: Metasystems: Measuring and Modulating Complex Behavior with a Pi-based Epistemology
items.description: Defines a “metasystem” as an alignment between behavior, context, and interpretation. Proposes a “clearness score” based on a constraint (tending to π) that ensures meaning remains usable. Framed as a knowledge theory bridging symbolic AI and pragmatic idealism.

items.title: The Revival of the Left in Latin America: Implications for the International System
items.description: Analyzes Latin America’s “Pink Tide” in the early 21st century, exploring factors behind the electoral success of left-wing movements. Draws links with historical US influence and economic patterns, interpreting the phenomenon as a pushback against neoliberal hegemony with nuanced outcomes.

items.title: The Eye of War: Military Perception from the Telescope to the Drone
items.description: Examines the evolving role of perception in warfare, from early optical instruments to modern drones. Argues that shifts in “scopic regime” – how battle is seen and depicted – have transformed military strategy, ethics, and the experience of conflict, merging warfighting with observation.

items.title: Good Enough: The Tolerance for Mediocrity in Nature and Society
items.description: Proposes that nature and human institutions often operate on a “good enough” principle rather than optimizing for perfection. From biological systems to economics and politics, the book suggests that tolerating imperfection is a feature of resilience and practicality, challenging obsession with maximal efficiency or purity.

items.title: A Rosetta Stone of Three Grammars: Sephiroth, π Theory, and the kOA Digital Ecosystem
items.description: Uses the Rosetta Stone metaphor to triangulate meaning across three parallel “grammars” (Sephiroth, π theory, and the kOA architecture). Argues that semantics must be deterministic (not rented from AI) and frames Kristal as a substrate that supports graded truth with provenance, validation, and upgrade paths.

items.title: Gather to Liberate: A Songline for the kOA Movement
items.description: A mytho-poetic narrative following a circle of animals that convenes to free the “Swarm” from a giant spider’s web. The allegory encodes a political blueprint: collective liberation via shared knowledge and deliberate coordination. Serves as an origin story and conceptual manifesto for the kOA movement.

items.title: Building with AI Without Building AI
items.description: Explains how to harness AI as a tool for co-creation without ceding decision-making authority to it. Outlines kOA’s approach to “building with AI”: using models for generative assistance while ensuring humans set goals, verify outputs, and retain moral and creative leadership.

items.title: kOA — Why We Need a Knowledge “Operating System” for Society
items.description: Argues that society lacks a shared “operating system” for knowledge and decision-making. Introduces kOA as an answer: a civic infrastructure that standardizes how we share, validate, and act on knowledge. Emphasizes the urgency of an open platform to coordinate complex problem-solving beyond siloed institutions.

items.title: What is the kOA Digital Ecosystem?
items.description: Introduces the concept of a “digital ecosystem” designed for civic collaboration. Describes kOA’s architecture as a system-of-systems linking platforms (Konnaxion, Orgo) with a narrative layer (King Klown mythos). Emphasizes modularity, open participation, and a deterministic semantic core as key to its resilience.

items.title: The World Frozen: Diagnosing Our True Enemy
items.description: A reflective piece identifying “stagnation” (not chaos) as the chief threat to societies. Argues that fear of change leads to decay, and that embracing dynamic, collective evolution is the antidote. Serves as a thematic cornerstone for the King Klown narrative, framing the stakes of inaction versus transformation.

items.title: Under the Mask: Vulnerability as Strength
items.description: Explores the role of vulnerability in leadership and narrative. Using the King Klown character, it illustrates how revealing fears and flaws can galvanize trust and collective courage. Challenges the notion that leaders must appear infallible; instead, authenticity and openness become sources of strength.

items.title: Pi Theory: From a Circle’s Cut to a Cosmic Sequence
items.description: Proposes a fixed decoding procedure applied to the earliest digits of π (reversal, segmentation, A1Z26 with 0→O) yielding a six-block symbolic sequence interpreted as a compact cosmogony: love → good → divide → reunite → create → expand.

items.title: Divine “Logos” as First Program: Language, Code, and the Cosmic Author
items.description: Interprets “In the beginning was the Word” as describing a primordial computational act. Draws parallels between theological “Logos” and programming code, suggesting that the creation narrative can be read as launching a cosmic algorithm. Explores how this analogy frames new perspectives on meaning and creation.

items.title: Zero-Skim Philanthropy: A Blueprint for Directly Allocative Giving
items.description: Diagnoses inefficiencies in conventional charitable giving: funds skimmed by intermediaries and overhead. Proposes an alternative “zero-skim” model leveraging a digital platform for direct allocation, maximizing the fraction of donations reaching target beneficiaries. Connects conceptually to kOA’s ethos of transparency and efficiency.

items.title: Knowledge Commons Blueprint: From Scarcity to Synthesis
items.description: Advocates for treating knowledge as a public commons. Critiques artificial scarcity in academic and commercial information systems, proposing a blueprint for an open knowledge ecosystem (like kOA). Emphasizes synthesis over competition, with structures to support collaborative verification, reuse, and cumulative innovation.

items.title: Geometric Pooling: Weighted Consensus Beyond Majoritarianism
items.description: Presents a decision-making model where individual inputs are combined via geometric (multiplicative) pooling instead of arithmetic averaging or plurality voting. Argues this yields a form of consensus that respects intensity of preferences and expertise, aligning with kOA’s concept of weighted deliberation (“Smart Vote”).

Le Surreal : Innover par la Fiction pour Transformer le Réel

Nataq
items.description:
Nataq
Ríčard Dežarden ‧ 1990

Ti tse sontse, shcho slipyt’ z\u00eirky
Koly rozmovlyayesh iz vmurayuchym, yoho bil’ takyy solodkyy
Shchob znajty rozrukhu i vybyty tvarynu
Shchob znajty prytulok, ty krashche za vsikh nas
Ty znayesh, shcho ya ne mozhu mriyaty pro zhyttya bez tebe;
Ya pam’yataju vody, de ya kupavsya
Teper, koly ya zhyvu, ya mriyu vodnochas
Use moye âstvo khochhe, shchob ty buv ostannim
Ya ne khochu vmyraty na tsiy krutiy skeli
Na ochakh u inshykh, naruhanyy bohamy
Nemaye kvitiv, shchob kynuty na moye tílo
A khto bude byty v baraban proshchannya?
Shche raz kazhu tobi: ya pidu za toboju v yamu
Ale ya khochu zemli, o Natak, ty mene chuyesh?
Yakshcho vam tse pidkhodyt’, yakshcho zhyttya vykonuye nashi bazhannya
My budemo razom do kintsya chasiv
Ale ya tak khvylyuyusya; sv\u00etlovi zatyazhky
Trokhy bil’she z kozhnym dnem ​​tvoyâ movchannya mene hnityt’
Vidkryyte ochi i povach’te, shcho vovky dyvlyatsya na nas;
Vony vzhe vybraly; moment, zhertva
I os’ vono vtikaye v tse temne nebo
Podikh shamana zakhlynuvsya vid dokoriv sumlіnnya
Bach, vin tremtyt’ vid strakhu і pal’tsi v nіgo pochornіly
і poky ya liubliyu tebe, vin klichhe smert’
Yakshcho smert’ navazhytsya zanesty’s’ tak daleko
U tsikh ostannikh tumanakh, de zakвrbfіaіtвsvit
Bud’te vpevnenі, shcho vona pryide ne til’ky zarady n’oho;
Dobre zakhovaymo rany, yde za chyslom
O liubyy Natak, moye sertse dіyshlo vysnovku:
Ya vmyrayu vid bazhannya pomer’ v tsomu zhubnomu taborі
Tak, my propaly, yak nikhto іnsih”
Tak, my zablukaly, ale shche zhivі!
Vidkryyte ochi i podyvіmosya na tsu zghrayu ptakhіv
Shturm nevidomogo morya. Kudy vony idut’?
Ya kazhu, shcho tam ocheret.
Khodіmo podyvymos’! Khodіmo podyvymos’! Ya dumayu, ostrovy
Abo den vstaye, mene hodu’ i zakhodyt’
Na bozhevynnykh perakh і bezpechnykh pecherakh
Bude voda, tepla, yak tviy rot
Shchob divchynka narodilasya, zakryyte і ranuy’
Na tviy znak, na tviy holos, zіbranі pіd tvoyi spysy
Stada bizonіv vymagayut’ zhertv
і koly spalakhuye myasyats’ dostatku
Buri plodіv, shchob zhiv tviy syn
Tvoya dolya moya; my bil’she ne budemo іsty
My pidemo nerestytysya u vnutrіshnі savany
і ty rozpalish moє hole і kists’ke bazhannya
Dozvol’ meni krychaty tvoyu radist’, dozvol’ tobi vypl’unuty moye sertse!
і yakshcho yakymos’ dyvom nashi molytvy dosyagnut’
Shchob zaspolyty tskh bojevil’nykh bohіv, zacharovanykh bolem
Ya ne pohodyusya, shchob khto’s іz nykh zabraf mene nazad
Abo plakala pisok і yila korinnya
Ya ne povernayusya na mis’sya stari
Za zakonamy voyiny vykhodyat’ na polyany
Pam’yat’ gorut’, fackel u rukakh
Yakshcho meni dovedytsya povernutysya, ya povernusya do morya
Ya molodyy Natak, yak olenyatko na zor’
A zhyttya khochhe mene i khochhe, shchob ty pryiyshov
Rozbudymo ord’, chuiu blahannya!
Davayte pryvyazhemo ulamky do sechovykh mikhurіv kytiv
My pershymy skushchuyemo myhdal
Perekhrestymosya, perekhrestymosya! Prynesemo, khto khochhe
Liuby mene, dopomozhy meni! Bo miy zhіvіt khochhe rozkolotysya
Ya sytyy, Natak: meni znadobytsya vohon’

items.title: 7. Bonus – chants thématiques
items.description:
Chant thématique d’introduction (exemple “Nataq”—voir paroles dans “Description” sur la vidéo Nataq).
Chant thématique de conclusion (“Siccitu00e0” – reprise de Noemi, adaptée).

items.title: 8.1 Conclusion générale
items.description: Conclusion générale du programme (synchro des volets A, B, C).

items.title: 9. Implémentation – volet A
items.description: Volet A: éducation – formation – validation de bonnes pratiques – microcertification interinstitutionnelle. (KonnectED: échanges de “briques” pédagogiques – carrières modulaires).

items.title: 9.2 Implémentation – volet B
items.description: Volet B: R&D ouverte – échanges de modules – maturité collaborative. (KeenKonnect: documentation – nitrification des journées code, mutualisation de modules).

items.title: 9.3 Implémentation – volet C
items.description: Volet C: gouvernance – co-construction de la Loi – égalisation de l’accès aux résultats. (SmartVote / Ethikos: consultation structurée – égalisation du “pourquoi” (mérite / éthique) dans chaque question).

items.title: 10. Conclusion – programme global (1/2)
items.description: C’est la convergence (synchronisation) des espaces A, B, C qui forme l’épine dorsale commune du programme, et qui permet de créer des boucles logiques destinées à la fois à la prise de décision collective, à l’exécution et à la création (mobilisation).

items.title: 10.2 Conclusion – programme global (2/2)
items.description: Boucles d’orchestration: équivalence morale – diffusion narrative – calibration en retour sur système réel.

items.title: 11. Conclusion narrative (1/2)
items.description: Conclusion narrative: pointer vers la Kronique “Les balles de bien commun” pour boucler sur la stratégie d’implémentation (transposition fable → politique).

items.title: 11.2 Conclusion narrative (2/2)
items.description: Conclusion narrative: pointer vers la Kronique “Konvergence” pour boucler sur l’objectif éthique (transposition fable → réforme concrète).

items.title: Conclusion finale (dissolution) – La Métamorphose de Narcisse
Conclusion finale (coda) – “Vous entendez? On en meurt!”
Konnaxion
items.description: Modular civic-tech platform that connects people, knowledge, and projects across learning, R&D, governance, and culture, with domain- and ethics-aware weighting (Ekoh + Smart Vote).

items.title: Orgo
items.description: Multi-tenant nervous system for organisations: turns signals into Cases and Tasks, routes them via labels and roles, tracks execution, and surfaces Insights.

items.title: VotingMachine
items.description: Experiments on consultations and weighted readings.
